metas.name: 1 · ★ 4.8 · 2018 · Super Furball
metas.description: When a young girl acquires a secret superpower from her pet guinea pig, her ordinary life turns upside down. She decides to use her newfound powers to make a difference in the world.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.6 · 2022 · Super Furball Saves the Future
metas.description: Superhero Furball undertakes a mission to protect bees vital to the planet, but first must reform a school bully, whose redemption holds the key to saving the environment.
